description: Use when an agent needs what a Solana address holds in one call. Input: address. Output: JSON slot, SOL balance, every non-zero token (mint, token account, program, decimals, raw and decimal balance, frozen flag; first 50), counts of token and empty accounts. Chain state only, no prices. Bad input: 400, not charged. Example: ?address=CV8t6fnSsckB3bzJSVRxQjVvTgdB35q11Fu3eaF1nz8u Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

address.description: Wallet address on Solana mainnet (base58, 32 bytes). Bad input → 400 (not charged)

name: sol_wallet_balances
title: Solana wallet balances: SOL plus every SPL and Token-2022 token account in one call
